short_description: Every customer message, order and payment in one place — on your phone.
full_description:
Makutano Connect brings your customer conversations, orders and bookings together in one place, so nothing is forgotten between a message and a payment.

Open the app and the first thing you see is what needs you today: a payment waiting to be checked, a quotation the customer has not answered, an order ready to go out. Under it, the customers you were already in the middle of — with what stage each one has reached, not just who messaged last.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Read and reply to customer messages from your WhatsApp Business number, in one shared inbox
• See every enquiry, quotation, booking and order with its next step already worked out
• Take a conversation, or hand it to a colleague, and know who is answering
• Log an enquiry that arrived by phone or in person, in a few taps
• Get notified the moment a customer writes to a chat you are responsible for
• Follow payments from request to confirmation, with money always verified by a person

BUILT FOR HOW A SMALL BUSINESS ACTUALLY WORKS

Your team sees what their job needs. An owner sees the whole business; a consultant sees the customers assigned to them; whoever checks the money sees payments waiting to be verified. Nobody is shown a screen they cannot act on, and private conversations stay private.

The app adapts to what your business does. A tour operator sees enquiries, quotations and bookings. A shop sees orders and deliveries. You are never asked to work around features meant for someone else's business.

WORKS WITH YOUR EXISTING SETUP

Makutano Connect is the phone companion to the Makutano Connect web portal. Enquiries that arrive through your website, your WhatsApp number or your own systems all land in the same inbox, and anything you do on the phone is on the web the moment you look.

BEFORE YOU DOWNLOAD

This app is for businesses already using Makutano Connect. You will need an account created by your business — you cannot sign up inside the app. To set up a workspace for your business, visit connect.makutano.co.tz.

short_description: Ujumbe wa mteja, oda na malipo mahali pamoja — kwenye simu yako.
full_description:
Makutano Connect inakusanya mazungumzo ya wateja, oda na bookings mahali pamoja, ili kisipotee kitu kati ya ujumbe na malipo.

Ukifungua app, jambo la kwanza unaloona ni kinachokuhitaji leo: malipo yanayosubiri kuthibitishwa, quotation ambayo mteja hajaijibu, oda iliyo tayari kutoka. Chini yake, wateja uliokuwa unaendelea nao — na hatua ambayo kila mmoja amefikia, si tu nani aliyetuma ujumbe mwisho.

UNACHOWEZA KUFANYA

• Soma na jibu ujumbe wa wateja kutoka namba yako ya WhatsApp Business, katika inbox moja ya pamoja
• Ona kila enquiry, quotation, booking na oda pamoja na hatua inayofuata ikiwa tayari imeandaliwa
• Chukua mazungumzo, au mkabidhi mwenzako, na ujue nani anayejibu
• Andika enquiry iliyoingia kwa simu au ana kwa ana, kwa mibonyezo michache
• Pata taarifa mara mteja anapoandika kwenye mazungumzo unayohusika nayo
• Fuatilia malipo kutoka ombi hadi uthibitisho, huku fedha zikithibitishwa na mtu daima

IMETENGENEZWA KWA JINSI BIASHARA NDOGO INAVYOFANYA KAZI

Timu yako inaona kile kazi yao inahitaji. Mmiliki anaona biashara nzima; mshauri anaona wateja aliopewa; anayekagua fedha anaona malipo yanayosubiri kuthibitishwa. Hakuna anayeonyeshwa skrini asiyoweza kuifanyia kazi, na mazungumzo binafsi yanabaki binafsi.

App inajibadilisha kulingana na biashara yako. Kampuni ya utalii inaona enquiries, quotations na bookings. Duka linaona oda na usafirishaji. Hutalazimika kuzunguka vipengele vilivyokusudiwa biashara ya mtu mwingine.

INAFANYA KAZI NA MFUMO WAKO ULIOPO

Makutano Connect ni mwenzi wa simu wa mfumo wa Makutano Connect wa mtandaoni. Enquiries zinazoingia kupitia tovuti yako, namba yako ya WhatsApp au mifumo yako mingine zote zinafika kwenye inbox moja, na chochote unachofanya kwenye simu kinaonekana mtandaoni mara moja.

KABLA HUJAPAKUA

App hii ni kwa biashara zinazotumia Makutano Connect. Utahitaji akaunti iliyotengenezwa na biashara yako — huwezi kujisajili ndani ya app. Kuanzisha workspace kwa biashara yako, tembelea connect.makutano.co.tz.

WhatsApp ni alama ya biashara ya Meta Platforms, Inc. Makutano Connect haihusiani na wala haijaidhinishwa na Meta.
